subject.title: fix(sessions): enforce exact owner equality for all parent session use

question: After the race is repaired, should plugin-runtime callers permanently fail closed on every legacy ownerless session row, or should OpenClaw provide a migration or repair path?
rationale: Current source cannot determine whether historical ownerless rows are user-owned state or unattributed plugin-created state, so denial versus migration is a security and upgrade-policy decision.

options.title: Fail closed on ownerless rows
options.body: Require exact persisted owner equality and accept that operators must recreate or explicitly migrate affected legacy sessions.

options.title: Require migration before enforcement
options.body: Add a narrow doctor or storage migration that safely attributes known legacy plugin sessions before enabling exact equality.

recommendation.title: Fail closed on ownerless rows
recommendation.body: Require exact persisted owner equality and accept that operators must recreate or explicitly migrate affected legacy sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged history shows the strongest ownership of Gateway session creation, reset, grouping, and lifecycle behavior in the affected files.
